title: Dungeon Runners is in a Box
description: Dungeon Runners is in a Box — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Bling Gnome

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: You can get a virtual Dungeon Runners box and experience what it might be like to own a REAL copy of the Dungeon Runners box.

Quest Reward: None listed

Return to: Bling Gnome

Repeatable: No

Zone: Townston

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: You can get a virtual Dungeon Runners box and experience what it might be like to own a REAL copy of the Dungeon Runners box.

Offer:

Go buy Dungeon Runners now, fool!

Turn-in:

Here is your very own Dungeon Runners box... actually make that 3. If you open a box, you will learn a temporary version of the Bling Gnome skill! But, be aware that when you open it, you will only have the Bling Gnome skill until you log out. You will have to open another box to get another Bling Gnome the next time you log in.

If you want a permanent Bling Gnome, you will need to purchase the Dungeon Runners box (in real life). Check out this [Web page] for more info on where to buy it.

You only get these 3 and that is it, so use them wisely... or go buy the freakin' box!

Level range: 1–100
